evidence: native simulation; user performs hardware testing
moving_fall_recovery: at least one real in-episode fall followed by stable recovery and resumed command
randomized_domains: separate stress evaluation; disclose failures without hardware qualification
baseline: exact 1346 locomotion parent at same seeds, domain draws, cases and physics
training_scope: bounded small-update blocks; inspect behavior before each extension
complete_definition: completed 12 s episode; last 2 s >=95% frames stable and abs(vx error)<.25 m/s and abs(yaw error)<.4 rad/s
revision_reason: User explicitly permits high stance overall excursion below approximately10cm if it slowly recenters and does not continue drifting in one direction. Preserve low/mid5cm and vibration/clearance/mechanical/getup/motion requirements.
preserved_metrics: Keep original uninterrupted 2 s success counts alongside practical endpoint. This is a metric correction, not a policy improvement.
confirmation_rule: Apply the frozen metric to fresh matched two-seed confirmation before export; family rates/minimums and standing/arc/HF limits unchanged.
user_preference: 200Hz; high stance<=.10m with slow recentering and no sustained outward drift; low/mid<=.05m; no rapid wheel/leg oscillation or wheel lift
additional_metrics_scope: 3..95 Hz target and actual motion, preserving original 20..95 Hz metrics

high_recentering.definition: True simulatorXY relative to first active frame; all30s within10cm. Final10s mean radial offset <=max(5cm,80percent of peak) and final10s outward radial linear trend<=1mm/s. Slow inward motion is allowed.
high_recentering.scope: Finite30s behavioral check, not a claim of infinite-time station keeping or wheel-odometry accuracy
